title: helianthemum pannosum f. alpinum
intro: Helianthemum pannosum f. alpinum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum pannosum f. alpinum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been isolated and studied for their medicinal potential.
